LJCDataValues.summary: Represents a collection of DbValue objects.
LJCDataValues.remarks: A DbValue collection element can also be retrieved by name using the collection object: values["PropertyName"];

LJCKeys.summary: Gets or sets the key columns.

Item.summary: The column for the specified property name.

LJCChanged.summary: Gets a collection of changed columns.

LJCClearChanged.summary: Sets the IsChanged value to false for all elements in the collection.

LJCCreateColumns.summary: Creates combined LJCDataColumns from LJCDataColumns and LJCDataValues.

LJCKeyPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the collection items.

LJCPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the collection items.

Add.summary: Creates the Object from the arguments and adds it to the collection.
Add.returns: A reference to the added item.

LJCGetUnique.summary: Returns the column that matches the key columns.

LJCSort.summary: Sorts on the current key columns.

LJCBoolean.summary: Gets the column object value as a bool.

LJCGetByte.summary: Gets the column object value as a byte.

LJCGetChar.summary: Gets the column object value as a char.

LJCGetDbDateTime.summary: Gets the column object value as a DateTime.

LJCGetDecimal.summary: Gets the column object value as a decimal value.

LJCGetDouble.summary: Gets the column object value as a double.

LJCInt16.summary: Gets the column object value as a short int.

LJCInt32.summary: Gets the column object value as an int.

LJCInt64.summary: Gets the column object value as a long int.

LJCGetSingle.summary: Gets the column object value as a single.

LJCString.summary: Gets the string value for the column with the specified name.

LJCValue.summary: Gets the string value for the column with the specified name.

LJCSetValue.summary: Sets the value for the column with the specified name.
